buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Technical Specifications & Quality Standards ISI/BIS Certification: Products supplied must be ISI-certified (wherever applicable), bra nd new, in good condition, and strictly as per the technical specifications outlined in t he bid. Genuineness & Prohibition of Second-Hand Goods: All items supplied must be 100% g enuine, authentic, and of the original brand. Supplying second-hand, refurbished, dup licate, replica, or counterfeit products is strictly prohibited. Any violation will lead to i mmediate rejection of the goods and strict penal action. Packaging & Inspection: Items must be delivered in original manufacturer packaging with proper labelling, warranty cards, and standard accessories. Delivered goods will undergo strict inspection by the buyer's committee, and any sub-standard items will b e rejected outright at the supplier's sole risk and cost. 2. Delivery Schedule & Liquidated Damages (Late Penalty)

Timeline: Items must be delivered within the stipulated delivery period as mentioned in the bid. Late Penalty: If delivery is delayed beyond the expected delivery date, a penalty dedu ction of 0.5% per week (or part thereof) of the undelivered value will be automatically enforced. 3. Cancellation Rights & Rejection Policy Cancellation: If the bid is cancelled by the buyer for administrative reasons, the seller shall not raise any objections. Return of Rejected Goods: If goods are rejected for any reason during inspection, the seller is fully responsible for taking them back at their own cost within the specified ti meframe. 4. Financial Turnover Requirement (Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024) Bidders must have an average minimum annual turnover of ₹0.99 Lakh over the last 3-year period, supported exclusively by a valid Chartered Accountant (CA) certificate. Startup Exemption: Startups recognized by DPIIT, holding a valid Udyam certificate, a nd registered as MSEs with CSPO or NSIC are exempt from prior experience and mini mum turnover requirements, provided their annual production capacity is at least twi ce the bid quantity. (Note: Resellers/traders do not qualify for startup benefits). 5. Eligible Entities: MSE Manufacturers/Service Providers with valid Udyam and CSPO/NSIC re gistration. DPIIT-recognized Startups with Udyam and CSPO/NSIC registration as MSE s. Bidders verified through the GeM Vendor Assessment process for the prim ary product category. High-turnover OEMs or service providers with an annual turnover of INR 5 00 Crore or more. Sellers holding a valid BIS license for the primary product category.
